custody.password_source: durable vault input before registry creation
custody.interrupted_create: Stop. Inspect exact robot ID, project, name and permissions before native import. Apply the original vault input only; never retry creation blindly.
custody.provisioning_token_delivery: local only; never ARC, hosts, Kubernetes or provider subprocesses

permissions.github-arc: Selected trusted private test repository only; Administration write and Metadata read. No organization runner registration.
permissions.github-release-public: Separate public App; selected public platform and fixture targets only; Contents and Pull requests write, Metadata read.
permissions.github-release-private: Separate private App; selected private configuration and fixture targets only; Contents and Pull requests write, Metadata read.
permissions.gitlab-state-harbor: Independent private HTTP state backend; state and lock access; no lab dependency.

owners.database_blobs_signatures: Harbor-specific coordinated recovery; no implicit shared CNPG or S3 migration

installation_apply: docker compose run --build --rm -e ANSIBLE_RUN_TAGS=harbor -e ANSIBLE_SKIP_TAGS=always lab apply; requires accepted identity, private DNS and storage. Skip unrelated host argument checks only; Harbor source, owner and identity gates remain. Full prove runs without tag selection.

recovery_signing.provision: docker compose run --build --rm --entrypoint python infra-harbor -m automation.harbor.signatures provision; then apply Harbor so ESO delivers the public verifier.
recovery_signing.prove: docker compose run --rm --entrypoint python infra-harbor -m automation.harbor.signatures prove; then verify the populated coordinated restore.
recovery_signing.custody: Generate the private P-256 key locally once and durably read it back from the vault before deriving a separate public-only item. Preserve both items on repeat; reject changed bindings. Temporary signing keys stay in local container memory storage. Never deliver the private signer or provisioning token to hosts or Kubernetes.
recovery_signing.scope: Operator recovery artifacts only, separate from CI signing identity. Sign exact deployment and five rollback digests per project through its push robot. No public transparency upload. Native restore verification uses the retained public key and isolated emergency recovery access.
recovery_signing.interruption: Preserve the original digest, image and public-key journal. Native verification skips existing valid signatures; never replace the signer or artifact set automatically.

browser.client: harbor; confidential, exact /c/oidc/callback and /oauth2/callback on the private origin
browser.authorization: OIDC group /platform-admin only for system administration; explicit project membership for other groups
browser.sessions: Absolute 240-second browser gate; no refresh. Machine registry/token and explicitly authenticated API routes remove cookies.
browser.prerequisites: OIDC mode, core-pod TLS discovery of the exact platform issuer, disabled registration and admin-only project creation before human onboarding.
browser.recovery: Vault admin via explicit Basic-authenticated private API; no interactive Keycloak dependency.

proof.prerequisite: Run lab identity-scoped after a public source update so the retired identity owner's receipt matches its reconciled revision.
proof.prepare: gh auth token | docker compose -f automation/harbor/compose.sessions.yaml run --build --rm -T harbor-session-controller prepare
proof.run: Start harbor-browser with the same Compose file, then pipe gh auth token to harbor-session-controller run. Requires the unchanged accepted API root and completed independent artifact proof.
proof.custody: Disposable platform viewer only; credentials, CLI secrets and browser sessions stay in process memory. Browser has no vault token, host credentials, backend access or persistent profile.
proof.interruption: After a final API check fails, pipe gh auth token to harbor-session-controller verify before cleanup; bounded observations are retained without session secrets and require the same source, disabled identity, private tombstone and preservation fingerprint. Otherwise cleanup before another prepare. Cleanup preserves original vault items and the private tombstone. Stop harbor-browser after the proof.

recovery.token_key_encoding: Canonical vault key and certificate stay unchanged. A restricted init container converts the same RSA key to PKCS#1 in memory for Harbor/libtrust; no generated or persisted replacement key.
recovery.source: Three retained Longhorn claims; independent PostgreSQL, Valkey and filesystem blobs
recovery.consistency: Argo-owned writer shutdown, database/artifact inventory, three cold snapshots and isolated restore with current vault signing inputs
recovery.offsite: Existing native Longhorn B2 target; day 1 UTC only, AES256, one verified generation after successful off-site restore; zero retained local generations
recovery.interruption: Protected maintenance, capture and retention receipts; local checks cannot consume a monthly candidate. Resume original Application values; preserve previous remote generation until proof completes.
recovery.bootstrap: Record source revision, chart checksum and upstream image pins. Restore rejects artifact version changes; use the recorded checkout. Compose execution never requires ARC or Harbor.
recovery.independent_retrieval: docker compose run --rm --entrypoint python service -m automation.harbor.independent; monthly window only, vault reader and B2, no VM or lab DNS. Check all compressed blocks and durable vault material; retain no downloaded backup files.
recovery.freshness: Daily local-only receipt check; no B2 calls. Missing first export, stale generation or a failed last attempt remains unhealthy.
